_comment: English installer catalog (Mission 168, ticket 05). Same keys as catalog.fr.json and catalog.es.json -- tests/test-catalog-key-parity.ps1 verifies this. Placeholders use .NET composite-format syntax ({0}, {1}, ...), applied with the -f operator.
questionnaire.assistantName.prompt: What name would you like to give your assistant?
questionnaire.workspace.prompt: Where should your Second Brain workspace live?
questionnaire.workspace.error.blankOrYes: '{0}' is not a workspace path (yes/no answers and a blank line are not accepted here). Enter an absolute path, for example {1}.
questionnaire.workspace.error.notAbsolut: '{0}' is not an absolute path. Enter an absolute path, for example {1}.
questionnaire.workspace.error.insideSour: '{0}' is inside the source repository being installed from and cannot be used as the workspace. Choose a path outside it, for example {1}.
questionnaire.activity.prompt: What do you do, in one sentence?
questionnaire.aiTools.prompt: How do you work with AI? (comma-separated: claude-code, codex, claude-ai, chatgpt)
verdict.success: Installation complete: everything is in place.
update.header: Here is what was recorded previously:
update.noChangeNote: Nothing changed: no file was modified.
cause.networkUnreachable: Network unreachable while downloading a required tool.
remedy.networkUnreachable: Check your internet connection, then run the installer line again.
remedy.generic: Review the error above; once it is fixed, run the installer line again to resume.
projectBootstrap.linkConflicts.header: Note: {0} link(s) already occupied by something else in this project -- left untouched, the existing file/folder always wins:
projectBootstrap.linkConflicts.howToOver: To use Second Brain's version of one of these instead, remove or rename the existing item at that path yourself, then rerun.
projectBootstrap.codexBudgetFallback: Note: combined skill description budget exceeds the Codex ceiling in this project -- Codex received skills/ only, Claude Code received everything (Doctrine rule 3).
projectBootstrap.assistantSlugMissing: Note: no assistant slug found in this clone's own carnet -- skills were linked into this project, the assistant was not (HYPOTHESIS: never generated, or a carnet older than this feature).
projectBootstrap.externalImportApproval: Note: the first time you open this project in Claude Code, it will ask for a one-time approval (an external import) because the assistant/skills links above point outside this project's folder -- answer yes, it only grants read access to second-brain (see the README's FAQ).
